comment: Mirrors interceptors/inspect-mcp/tsconfig.json (NodeNext + strict), scoped to the openclaw-inspect-plugin package. noEmit-only: the plugin ships as raw .ts (OpenClaw loads it through jiti), and its imports reach into the sibling ../inspect-mcp/src sources (the REUSED security core), which an emitting rootDir could not contain. Tests use the inspect-mcp mock arbiter + mock UllmClient and never resolve the real arbiter package or OpenClaw.
